functions.name: abi_version
functions.description: Return ABI version 1. This does not open a capability or authorize a resource.

functions.name: capability_open
functions.description: Open one explicitly granted alias in the caller Instance and selected backend. Write an opaque eight-byte little-endian handle on success.

functions.name: capability_close
functions.description: Retire this handle generation. The handle may already be retired if later Gateway cleanup returns an error.

functions.name: capability_revoke
functions.description: Revoke the alias for this Instance/backend, invalidating all its open sibling handles. Reopening cannot restore the revoked grant.

functions.name: topic_publish
functions.description: Publish one canonical generated message through a separately granted publisher alias.

functions.name: topic_subscribe
functions.description: Activate a separately granted subscription queue. Receive messages through event_poll on the guest execution thread.

functions.name: event_poll
functions.description: Poll a topic, service-request, incoming-goal or ROS2 parameter-event queue. Error 11 means no event; no native callback enters Wasm.

functions.name: event_watch
functions.description: Bind separately granted event.observe and source owners. Correlation is nonzero only when an owned outgoing Action data kind is selected; metadata-only watches use zero and activate/consume no native payload. No aliases or rights are created.

functions.name: event_poll_v1
functions.description: Read one complete versioned64-byte-header event. Error90 writes required size and retains the event; error11 is idle. No automatic replay.

functions.name: event_ready
functions.description: Write32 little-endian bytes: ready count,next record bytes,admission slots,admission bytes. A readiness snapshot is not a reservation.

functions.name: service_submit
functions.description: Admit one bounded asynchronous service request. A successful acknowledgement writes requestID; completion requires explicit service-response and resource-error observation. Never replay a timeout.

functions.name: service_call
functions.description: Call the explicitly selected service using its canonical request/response type and configured deadline. Do not automatically replay a timed-out call.

functions.name: service_advertise
functions.description: Activate the explicitly granted service server. Poll owned request IDs through event_poll.

functions.name: service_respond
functions.description: Respond to an owned live request using a separate response grant and u64 request-ID-prefixed canonical response.

functions.name: action_send_goal
functions.description: Send the selected trusted Action goal codec and receive an opaque u64 Goal ID. Builtin Fibonacci uses one canonical i32 order. Generated bounded Actions require their registered goal codec; all bounds remain explicit.

functions.name: action_cancel_own_goal
functions.description: Request cancellation of one owned Goal using its u64 ID and a separately authorized cancel capability.

functions.name: action_cancel_any_goal
functions.description: Use the separately granted any-cancel operation. Goal ID zero is valid only for this independently authorized operation.

functions.name: action_receive_feedback
functions.description: Receive ID8 plus the selected trusted Action feedback codec for an owned Goal. Builtin Fibonacci appends count32/int32 values; an empty queue returns 11.

functions.name: action_receive_result
functions.description: Receive ID8/outcome8 plus the selected trusted terminal result codec. Builtin Fibonacci appends count32/int32 values. Successful terminal consumption retires ownership.

functions.name: action_advertise
functions.description: Activate the explicitly granted Action server with an empty command. Poll ID8 plus the selected trusted goal codec; builtin Fibonacci uses i32 order. Responses require another grant.

functions.name: action_respond
functions.description: Send ID8/kind8 plus the selected trusted feedback/result codec. Builtin Fibonacci appends count32/int32 values. Advertiser and responder require the same explicit ROS2 QoS contract.

functions.name: tf_lookup
functions.description: Request the separately configured source/target frame pair at u64 nanoseconds; zero selects the latest admitted transform.

functions.name: tf_broadcast
functions.description: Broadcast one canonical TransformStamped for the separately configured frame pair. Do not normalize its quaternion implicitly.

functions.name: parameter_get
functions.description: Read the value fixed by the capability type. An empty request does not select a different node, name or value kind.

functions.name: parameter_set
functions.description: Set a canonical value of the explicitly granted parameter type. Numeric and element bounds remain enforced by the host.

functions.name: parameter_delete
functions.description: Delete the explicitly granted ROS1 parameter using an empty request; no implicit parent-name authority is added.

functions.name: parameter_exists
functions.description: Query existence of the explicitly granted ROS1 parameter; decode one canonical Bool response.

functions.name: parameter_list
functions.description: List the separately authorized parameter scope; decode the bounded canonical String result.

functions.name: parameter_search
functions.description: Search the explicitly granted ROS1 resource with an empty request. Parent namespaces are included only with search-parent-namespaces=true, for the same final key and within allowed-name-prefix before every native query.

functions.name: graph_inspect_topic
functions.description: Inspect the configured topic filter with an empty request and decode sorted canonical String rows.

functions.name: graph_inspect_node
functions.description: Inspect the configured node filter with an empty request and decode sorted canonical String rows.

functions.name: graph_inspect_service
functions.description: Inspect the configured service filter with an empty request and decode sorted canonical String rows.

functions.name: graph_list_topics
functions.description: List topics within the explicit exact/prefix graph filter; decode sorted canonical String rows.

functions.name: graph_list_nodes
functions.description: List nodes within the explicit graph filter; this is not unrestricted discovery authority.

functions.name: graph_list_services
functions.description: List services within the explicit graph filter; decode sorted canonical String rows.

functions.name: time_read_ros
functions.description: Read the separately authorized ROS clock domain as little-endian u64 nanoseconds.

functions.name: time_read_wall
functions.description: Read the independently authorized ROS1 wall clock; another time grant does not imply this one.

functions.name: log_write
functions.description: Write one canonical String to the separately granted ROS logger. This does not open a file or socket.
